rows: A name that refers to the same object in all possible worlds
Yes (Kripke): "Aristotle" picks out Aristotle in every world
Meaning is not in the head — it depends on the external world (Putnam)
A necessary truth discovered empirically: "Water is H₂O"
Possible worlds are real, concrete, existing entities — as real as ours
Modal statements about individuals are about their counterparts in other worlds
P □→ Q: Q is true in the closest possible worlds where P is true
